senses.gloss: (denom. of פֶּחָם) to be black, v. infra.

to blacken. Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55ᵈ; Tosef. Maas. Sh. V, 13 בית ע״ז מְפַחֲמִין אותו בפיחמין the site of an idolatrous temple is marked by blackening it (its debris) with coal. Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵃ bot. [read:] מה … ומפציע ומְפַחֵם כך אני יורד בו as a kettle (thrown at a person) scalds and wounds and blackens, so will I come down at him; a. e.—Part. pass. מְפוּחָם; f. מְפוּחֶמֶת; pl. מְפוּחָמִים, מְפוּחָמִין; מְפוּחָמוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00974"><he>כָּעַר</he></cite>; Y. Taan. I, end, 64ᵈ <he>חם יצא מפ׳</he> Ham came out (of the ark) black. Y. Sot. II, 17ᵈ bot. <he>לא במפ׳</he> not in a sooty vessel.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>ידיה מפ׳</he> her hands were blackened.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>את שכולך מפ׳</he> thou (negress) who art black all over; a. e.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764">Yalk. Num. 764</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982:8">Yalk. Cant. 982</cite> <he>נפ׳ בשמש</he> became black through exposure to the sun, v. <cite ref="K01208"><he>כִּרְכֵּם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:5">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> <he>נִתְפַּחֲמוּ פני הנשים מפני השמש</he> the faces of the (Jewish) women had become black &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. <he>ככלי פשתן … מִתְפַּחֲמִין קימעא וכ׳</he> (a scholar’s reputation is) like the fine linen clothes from Bethshan, if they are in the least stained, they are ruined; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:18:1">Koh. R. to I, 18</cite> <he>אם נִתְפַּחֲמוּ וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1:10">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ונתפחמו ידיה</he> and her hands were soiled with soot; <he>אם מקנחת … מתפחם</he> if she wipes her hands on the wall, the wall will be soiled; a. fr.
